note: Re-quoted 2026-11-25 to the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0; library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz, read offline as owb-am), per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 (Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). This supersedes what the notes below say about the 1962 UBS Bible and about wording borrowed from other Amharic works: every `mined` row is now a verbatim OWB span in its block (exact OWB pieces may be joined with '…'); `self_rendered` rows are allusions and paraphrases left as the translator's prose, each with its `why`. Block indexes were realigned to the admin view's count. Job 42:6 and Gal 2:20's 'nevertheless I live' stay the translator's: the sermon argues from KJV words OWB does not have.
